t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The different colored gnomes on the left hand side tend to pay out more when it is x5 multiplier and the hat shapes of the gnome also play a role on the bonus.

vb_textbox.text: Depending if the brown, purple, blue, and red gnomes are on the left side with the 5x multiplier, the payout will be more. For example, if the gnome with the pointy brown hat is on the left side during the 5x multiplier next to the pink, the pointy brown gnome will pay out more.
